status: Development research view (E18). Not the production model; not deployed.
caveats: Regional hunger is one SWS Balance-Luzon value per quarter, not a provincial measurement.
Provincial food inflation and relative price pressure are price indicators, not food insecurity.
The HIGH/LOW label is a constructed composite (hunger + 2 x relative price pressure > 14.6); it is not independently measured provincial food insecurity.
A ranking always has a top province even when differences are small; D values are shown.
No forecast horizon met the E18 reliability working criterion; all forecasts are research outputs.

H.label: Research forecast of regional hunger (SWS Balance Luzon, % of families); not a forecast of provincial food insecurity.

F.label: Research forecast of provincial food inflation (YoY %); not food insecurity.

D.label: Research forecast of relative provincial food-price pressure (points vs the unweighted five-province mean); not food insecurity.

constructed_label.label: Research forecast of the constructed composite label (HIGH if regional hunger + 2 x relative price pressure > 14.6); NOT a measurement or forecast of provincial food insecurity.

lead_time.note: No horizon met the E18 working criterion (selected model, >=8 test quarters, >=5 HIGH and >=5 LOW cases). Chapter I does not define 'reliable'; adviser approval needed.
